description: This file defines the DdlScanner class responsible for tokenizing and parsing DDL (Data Definition Language) scripts or snippets used within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes methods for reading tokens, identifiers, literals, comments, and symbols, and manages position tracking within the source string.

classes.name: DdlScanner
classes.description: Sealed class responsible for tokenizing DDL input strings, providing methods to read and interpret tokens, handle whitespace, comments, string literals, and maintain parsing position.

methods.name: ReadCode
methods.description: Reads to the next DDL token, ignoring comments, and returns the identified symbol.

methods.name: PeekKeyword
methods.description: Peeks at the next keyword without advancing the cursor.

methods.name: PeekPunctuation
methods.description: Peeks at the next punctuation symbol without advancing the cursor.

methods.name: PeekSymbol
methods.description: Peeks at the next symbol (text, keyword, punctuation) without touching the parsing cursor.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text or \,keyword tokens, advancing the cursor appropriately.

methods.name: MoveToCode
methods.description: Advances to the next code token if current is None or a comment.

methods.name: MoveToParagraphContent
methods.description: Moves cursor to the first content character of a paragraph, skipping comments and empty lines.

methods.name: MoveToNextParagraphContentLine
methods.description: Advances to the next line of paragraph content, handling nested or block endings.

methods.name: IgnoreLineBreak
methods.description: Determines if a line break can be ignored based on previous symbol.

methods.name: ScanIdentifier
methods.description: Scans and returns an identifier symbol.

methods.name: ScanNumber
methods.description: Scans and returns a number (integer or real) literal.

methods.name: ScanKeyword
methods.description: Scans and identifies a keyword starting with a backslash.

methods.name: ScanPunctuator
methods.description: Scans and returns a punctuation symbol.

methods.name: ScanVerbatimStringLiteral
methods.description: Scans a verbatim string literal enclosed in @@"".

methods.name: ScanStringLiteral
methods.description: Scans a standard string literal, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: SaveCurDocumentPos
methods.description: Saves current parsing position for error reporting.
